description: Snapshot each VM through an endpoint on this proxy. Run on the proxy, usually by the pe_snapshot::create plan.

provider.description: Provider name. Checked against the endpoint, which is authoritative.

endpoint.description: Endpoint name, or a list of them, configured on this proxy by pe_snapshot::proxy. With a list, each VM is looked up on every endpoint and must be found on exactly one.

vms.description: The VMs to act on, as certname and the vm_id from the pe_snapshot fact.

credentials.description: Credentials to merge with the proxy credentials file. A key in both is an error.

concurrency.description: How many VMs to work on at once.

tag.description: Groups the snapshots from one run. Delete and restore select by it.

retention_hours.description: Hours until the sweep deletes the snapshot. Defaults to the proxy setting, refused above the proxy maximum. 0 means no expiry where the proxy allows it.

memory.description: Include RAM state where the provider supports it.

quiesce.description: Ask the provider to quiesce the guest filesystem where it supports that.

by.description: Recorded in the snapshot metadata as the creator.
